card.name: Start of rare names and paired terms
card.fires_on: Unpredictable word starts or joiners where a rare name or term is beginning, such as the first letter of a species name, 'and' between sea names, or 'Trans' in 'Transmitted'.

modes.label: Start of rare animal names
modes.description: A single capital letter or short start of an unusual animal name, often in nature text.

modes.description: The word 'and' joining two sea names in Arctic drilling text.

modes.label: Start of a longer word or acronym
modes.description: The first piece of an acronym, company name, or long medical word.
